profile.summary:
Hey Y’all,

I am Chris Terrell Jones, Lead Software Engineer at Chick-fil-A, working in Digital Embedded Intelligence Team. My focus is on developing Chick-fil-A's Research & Decelopment team building innovative solutions using Computer Vision, IoT, and more.

When I'm not at work, you'll find me at the gym, trying out new restaurants in Atlanta, reading about technology, or hiking up a mountain while snacking on Clif Bars somewhere in Georgia.

Feel free to reach out to me on LinkedIn if you're interested in grabbing coffee or having a chat over lunch
